login.title: Sign in to your file
login.intro: Enter the email address you used on the intake form. We will email you a one-time link — no password needed.
login.sent: If there is a file under that email address, a sign-in link is on its way. It works once and expires in 30 minutes — check your spam folder if it has not arrived in a few minutes.

errors.email: Please enter a valid email address.
errors.link: That sign-in link has expired or was already used. Request a new one below.
errors.locked: Too many attempts. Please wait 15 minutes and try again.

verify.title: Continue to your file
verify.expiredBody: Sign-in links last 30 minutes and work once.

file.notFoundTitle: We could not find your file
file.notFoundBody: Please sign out and sign in again with the email address you used on the form.
file.closedBody: Your service is complete and, as promised, your personal data and documents have been permanently deleted. Your invoice records are kept as Spanish tax law requires.
file.submitted: Thank you — your documents are with us. We check them within one business day.
file.checkoutCancelled: Payment was cancelled, and nothing was charged. You can pay whenever you are ready.
file.paymentBody: We start work as soon as your payment is confirmed.
file.padron: 3. Proof of address for the Padrón
file.padronIntro: To register at the Padrón — the city’s register of residents — you must show you live at {address}. What counts as proof depends on how you live.
file.tasaIntro: The police charge this fee separately from our service. It is paid in cash at a Spanish bank, using a form you generate on the police website.
file.reviewDone: Submitted on {date}. You can still upload a replacement if we ask for one.
file.reviewPrompt: When everything is uploaded, tell us and we will check your file.

invoices.empty: Your invoice appears here once payment is confirmed.

pay.failed: Could not open checkout. Please try again.

residence.title: A student residence
residence.detail: Halls or a residence with a reception desk

own-lease.title: A flat I rent
own-lease.detail: The lease is in my name

not-in-name.title: A room or sublet
not-in-name.detail: The lease is in someone else’s name, or I live with family or friends

residence.intro: Residences register their students with a special city form, the Autorització d’empadronament de domicili col·lectiu. The residence fills it in, signs it and stamps it — without the stamp it is not accepted. Send this message to reception:
residence.subject: Subject:
residence.uploadPrompt: When the residence gives it back, upload it here:
residence.spanishNote: The message is in Spanish on purpose: it is for the residence’s staff in Barcelona.

lease.intro: The city accepts your lease only if all three are true. Check each one:
lease.inMyName: My name is on the lease as a tenant.
lease.longEnough: It lasts more than three months, or says explicitly that it extends.
lease.language: It is written in Spanish or Catalan.
lease.notMine: Not in your name? Then the person on the lease must authorise you.
lease.tooShort: Lasts three months or less? Ask your landlord for an extension in writing, or to authorise you with the city’s form instead.
lease.otherLanguage: In another language? The city needs an official translation (a traducción jurada, or one from your consulate). A Spanish version from your landlord is often quicker — ask first.
lease.upload: Upload the full signed lease and a recent utility bill for the flat. The city asks for the bill when the lease is a copy or has expired; we ask for it every time so nothing holds you up.

sublet.intro: When the flat is not in your name, whoever holds it authorises you on Barcelona’s official form, the Autorització per inscriure-us al domicili.
sublet.signByHand: Print it. The person who authorises you signs it by hand; the signature must match their ID.
sublet.signDate: They write the date next to the signature. The authorisation is valid for three months from that date.
sublet.uploadBody: The city will not accept the form on its own. It needs the signer’s ID and proof that the flat is theirs to offer: the lease in their name, or the deed if they own it.

authorization.title: 1. Generate the authorisation
authorization.intro: The person who signs is whoever holds the flat: the owner, or the main tenant whose name is on the lease. We fill in Barcelona’s official form with your details and theirs. We do not keep what you type here.

signerName.label: Signer’s full name
signerName.hint: Exactly as on the signer’s ID.

signerId.label: Signer’s DNI, NIE or passport number

cadastralRef.label: Cadastral reference
cadastralRef.hint: 20 letters and digits, on the property tax (IBI) receipt. Leave blank if unknown.

authorization.tenantNote: When the main tenant signs, the form also asks for the owner’s details. You will find them on the lease.
authorization.forCompany: The signer acts for a company (for example a coliving operator)
authorization.done: ✓ Downloaded. Now print it and follow step 2.
authorization.notBarcelona: This is the City of Barcelona’s form, but your address is in {city}. Each municipality has its own Padrón authorisation — contact us and we will get the right one.
authorization.unprintable: These characters cannot be printed on the form: {chars}. Please write names in Latin letters, exactly as on the ID document.
authorization.unavailable: This form is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later or contact us.
authorization.failed: Could not generate the form. Please try again.

enrolment.intro: Your acceptance letter is not enough. Ask your university’s admissions or registry office for a certificado de matrícula, stamped and signed. This message asks for exactly what the immigration office looks for:
enrolment.spanishNote: The message is in Spanish on purpose: it is for your university’s office in Barcelona.
enrolment.subject: Subject:

tasa.missingNie: This step needs your NIE, and we do not have it yet. We will tell you as soon as you can do it — nothing to do for now.
tasa.open: Open the official Policía Nacional form:
tasa.fill: Fill in each box exactly as below (leave any other box empty).
tasa.tick: Tick only “{tramite}” — it should show {fee}. If the portal shows a different amount, the portal is right: pay what it shows.
tasa.print: Download the form and print it at 100% scale — never “fit to page”, or the barcode will not scan.
tasa.caption: What to type on the police portal
tasa.labelsNote: The box names are in Spanish because that is what the police website shows.
